question: A car leaves Town A at 7: 00 AM and travels towards Town B at a constant speed of 70 km/h. Another car leaves Town B at 9: 00 AM and travels towards Town A at a constant speed of 80 km/h. The distance between the two towns is 600 km. At what time will the two cars meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of car leaving Town A = 70 km/h

Speed of car leaving Town B = 80 km/h

Distance between Town A and Town B = 600 km

Time car leaves Town A = 7:00 AM

Time car leaves Town B = 9:00 AM

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed = Speed of car A + Speed of car B

Time taken = Distance &d
